observations.behavior: Adds OAuth authorization tests asserting that a blocklisted identity is rejected when an LLM gateway scope is requested, while still granting non-gateway scopes.
observations.posthog_connection: These tests guard against a regression where a user identity banned by the wizard blocklist could still receive an OAuth grant carrying an LLM gateway scope, which could bypass the ban. The implementation is not shown, so the tier is unassessed.

observations.behavior: Adds a new OAuth authorization helper, _gateway_blocklist_block, that checks the wizard identity blocklist before issuing an OAuth grant, and returns a 403 if blocked.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent a banned identity from receiving an OAuth grant carrying an LLM gateway scope. The tier is unassessed without the implementation of wizard_identity_blocked and GATEWAY_BEARING_SCOPES.
